leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply conditional logic to control what content renders based on component state
Implement ternary operator syntax to create inline conditional expressions in JSX
Use TypeScript type annotations to define boolean state variables for conditional rendering
Construct JSX expressions that return different UI elements depending on a condition
Execute state updates to toggle boolean values that drive conditional rendering
Define event handler functions to modify state and trigger re-renders
Utilize the useState hook to create and manage conditional rendering state
Access state variables within ternary expressions to determine which JSX to render
Return dynamic JSX structures that change based on component state
Control UI visibility by applying ternary operators to element attributes and content
